entities.summary: Dmytro Oleksandrovych Kozatskyi is a Ukrainian photographer, serviceman, senior soldier, and fighter of the Azov Brigade of the National Guard of Ukraine. He was awarded the Medal For Military Service to Ukraine (2022).
